test_title: PYST 49: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

C sits third to the left of F. B sits second to the left of E. F is an immediate neighbour of both G and B. D is not an immediate neighbour of C.

How many people sit between B and D, when counted from the right of B?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit around a circular table facing the centre.

C sits third to the left of F.

B sits second to the left of E.

F is an immediate neighbour of both G and B.

D is not an immediate neighbour of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47d826458ab220cdc23cffd7862d62f18d66e6dc80677018584a4cb4c5e508d5.png] 

So, there are 0 people between B and D.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
